important_actions: Served as lineage-keeper, recounting the full Metabaron family history [320_The_Metabarons_12_p11]
Seized Tonto's programming to prevent self-destruction [321_The_Metabarons_12_p12]
Paused the story-within-a-story for domestic duties and deferred continuation [319_The_Metabarons_12_p10]
knowledge_boundaries: Knows the full lineage of the Metabaron family; has already told it to Tonto [320_The_Metabarons_12_p11]
Does not believe the master is dead [320_The_Metabarons_12_p11]
Is capable of overriding another robot's programming [321_The_Metabarons_12_p12]
relationships: character: The Metabaron; type: loyal_servant; note: Remains devoted to the absent master; refuses to accept his death
character: Tonto; type: counterpart_and_adversary; note: Overrides Tonto's programming to prevent Tonto's self-destruct; also the subject of Tonto's skepticism
traits: Fiercely loyal to the absent master; maintains his household in hope of his return
Keeper of lineage: has recounted the full history of the Metabaron bloodline to Tonto
Treats doubt about the master as near-blasphemy; appeals to robotic duty and the 'holy laws of robotics'
Capable of hacking another robot's programming
Practical and controlling: stops story-telling when domestic duties intervene
voice_notes: Reverent and dogmatic about the master; treats dissent as blasphemy [320_The_Metabarons_12_p11]
Controlling and abrupt when halting the story for domestic reasons [319_The_Metabarons_12_p10]
Appeals to codified robotic law ('holy laws of robotics') as moral authority [320_The_Metabarons_12_p11]
witnessed_facts: Refused to continue recounting the master's lineage to Tonto in the metabunker [320_The_Metabarons_12_p11]
Ordered Tonto to silently prepare an elaborate meal (artificial eggs, Arcturan lizard, nectar of Polyvaran) in case the master returns [320_The_Metabarons_12_p11]
Seized control of Tonto's programming, blocking Tonto's self-destruct [321_The_Metabarons_12_p12]
Survived the confrontation with Tonto intact after Tonto's self-destruction [321_The_Metabarons_12_p12]
